professional_summary.content: sabrina (chronological age: 2 years, 10 months) was assessed using multiple standardized pediatric assessment tools to evaluate developmental functioning across cognitive, motor, communication, and sensory processing domains. The comprehensive evaluation revealed both areas of emerging strengths, such as social engagement and learning potential, and areas requiring targeted intervention including fine motor coordination, attention and focus, and communication skills. These delays, which impact functional performance and daily activities, necessitate the initiation of occupational therapy services aimed at enhancing developmental outcomes. A multidisciplinary approach involving speech-language therapy, occupational therapy, and early intervention services, focused on family-centered practices, will be beneficial in addressing these needs. With consistent family involvement and education, sabrina is expected to make meaningful progress in these areas. Regular monitoring and reassessment are crucial to track developmental progress and refine intervention strategies, thus providing a foundation for sustained developmental success.
